sources.scope: Describes SL, OJ, LO and ZJ overhang pairs. LO can leave a Hanging S; ZJ needs contextual Z accounting. ZJ can be built in either order, and placement order depends on the position. A matching shape alone does not establish whole-run piece balance.

sources.label: Flamewheel's ST Stacking Guide
sources.scope: Explains two-piece center combinations with an open lower-right corner and a level three-wide top; capping here means finishing a combination. Its color-based piece names differ from current Guideline letters.
